# ADR-019: Main session pin with outage failover; local-only canonicalize decided at init

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Date:** 2026-11-10

## Decision
**1. Pin.** The main session stays on one model: no routine, cost-driven, or quality-driven switching. **2. Failover.** On a provider outage the main role may move down its fallback chain at a turn boundary, only when protocol state shows the provider never accepted the turn (ADR-016), only to a model with the same tools, with one notice to the owner. The new model stays pinned until restart or until the owner reverts it. **3. Local-only defaults.** `canonicalize` and `curiosity` default to local-only only if `jaari llm eval` qualifies a local model at `jaari init`. Otherwise `init` asks the owner to install a local model or allow an API tier for those roles, and canonicalize does not run until they choose. Local-only roles that are configured keep failing closed with one notice (ADR-011). **4. Status.** ADR-011 and ADR-012 are Accepted with these amendments; ADR-013 stays Proposed until OQ-29 is verified.

## Alternatives rejected
A hard pin that stops the agent in an outage; free switching per turn (cache loss, persona drift); silently running canonicalize on an API tier; silently not running it.
